TaskDescription: Targeted memory reactivation during NREM sleep: 25 cued sounds (paired during learning) and 25 new control sounds (guitar strum) presented ~5.5 s apart over white noise (~55 dB SPL). Segment extracted by the authors from 10 s before the first stimulus to 10 s after the last stimulus.
Instructions: No task instructions during sleep: lights off, low-intensity white noise (~55 dB SPL) from a Bluetooth speaker ~0.5 m from the head; sound cues presented once the participant entered NREM stage 2 or 3 (Duan et al. 2025 Nat Commun 16:2472, doi:10.1038/s41467-025-57766-x, Methods).
InstitutionName: Sanbo Brain Hospital, Capital Medical University
iEEGReference: Not documented in the release; signals as exported by the authors ("Raw intracranial electrophysiological signals"). The paper's re-referencing (common average / nearby white-matter contact) and notch filtering were analysis steps and are not applied here.
ElectrodeManufacturer: Huake-Hengsheng Medical Technology Co. Ltd, Beijing, China
iEEGElectrodeInfo: Intracerebral multiple-contact electrodes, 8-16 contacts, contact length 2 mm, diameter 0.8 mm, inter-contact distance 1.5 mm (Duan et al. 2025)
iEEGPlacementScheme: Stereotactic depth electrodes, robot-assisted implantation, placement by clinical needs
iEEGElectrodeGroups: Recorded contacts grouped by electrode label (letter part of the release channel name, prime included), 12 labels (number of recorded contacts per label): A' (9), B' (9), C' (9), D' (8), E' (8), G' (10), P' (9), H' (14), J' (9), M' (8), T' (9), Y' (8). Stereotactic depth electrodes with 8-16 contacts each (paper).
EpilepticActivity: No seizure occurred during the task period and sleep (Duan et al. 2025).
iEEGGround: n/a (not documented in the paper or the Zenodo release)
SoftwareVersions: n/a (acquisition software not documented; the Zenodo record states the data were processed using MATLAB 2019b)
